exams.name: Nursing Facility Administrator Licensing Examination
exams.notes: The executive commissioner may establish additional educational requirements for applicants who fail the exam three times. The written portion, if any, must be validated by a testing professional.
exams.quote: An applicant for a nursing facility administrator's license must take a licensing examination under this subchapter.

interval_years.quote: A license is valid for two years.

required.quote: The executive commissioner by rule shall establish a minimum number of hours of continuing education required to renew a license under this subchapter.

available.quote: The department shall issue a provisional license to an applicant currently licensed in another jurisdiction who seeks a license in this state

requirements.value: Applicant must have been licensed in good standing as a nursing facility administrator for at least two years in another jurisdiction with substantially equivalent requirements, passed a national or other recognized examination, and be sponsored by a person licensed by the department.
requirements.quote: has been licensed in good standing as a nursing facility administrator for at least two years in another jurisdiction, including a foreign country, that has licensing requirements that are substantially equivalent to the requirements of this subchapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly violated a provision of this subchapter or a rule adopted under it
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the license holder has wilfully or repeatedly violated a provision of this subchapter or a rule adopted under this subchapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully or repeatedly acted in a manner inconsistent with the health and safety of facility residents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the license holder has wilfully or repeatedly acted in a manner inconsistent with the health and safety of the residents of a facility of which the license holder is an administrator

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or attempted to obtain a license through misrepresentation, deceit, or material misstatement of fact on an application
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the license holder obtained or attempted to obtain a license through misrepresentation or deceit or by making a material misstatement of fact on a license application

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of alcohol or drugs creates a hazard to facility residents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the license holder's use of alcohol or drugs creates a hazard to the residents of a facility

disciplinary_grounds.description: A court of competent jurisdiction finds the license holder is mentally incapacitated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: a judgment of a court of competent jurisdiction finds that the license holder is mentally incapacitated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of a misdemeanor or felony involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the license holder has been convicted in a court of competent jurisdiction of a misdemeanor or felony involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of an offense listed in Section 250.006
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the license holder has been convicted in a court of competent jurisdiction of an offense listed in Section 250.006

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligent or incompetent in duties as a nursing facility administrator
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the license holder has been negligent or incompetent in the license holder's duties as a nursing facility administrator

definition_quote.value: the performance of the acts of administering, managing, supervising, or being in general administrative charge of a nursing facility
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of nursing facility administration" means the performance of the acts of administering, managing, supervising, or being in general administrative charge of a nursing facility.

value: being in general administrative charge of a nursing facility
methods_authorized.quote: the performance of the acts of administering, managing, supervising, or being in general administrative charge of a nursing facility

temporary_permit_available.quote: The executive commissioner by rule may provide for the issuance of a temporary license.

facility_type_covered.quote: "Nursing facility" means an institution or facility that is licensed as a nursing home, nursing facility, or skilled nursing facility by the department under this chapter.

experience_substitutable_for_education.quote: An applicant who has not completed the course of instruction and training described by Subsection (c) must present evidence satisfactory to the department of having completed sufficient education, training, and experience in the fields described by Subsection (c) to enable the applicant to engage in the practice of nursing facility administration.

interdepartmental_deficiency_reporting_r.quote: The executive commissioner shall by rule establish criteria to determine whether deficiencies from a facility's survey warrant action against an administrator.
